bundle.shortDescription: Rook — your workroom, on this computer.
bundle.longDescription: Rook is a calm, Bot-first workroom. The desktop app puts chats, Bots, files, approvals, and your local file workspaces in one Tauri window, and runs a supervised, version-pinned Chromium on your own computer so your Bots can do real work — under your control.
